legend_notes: This view = upstream agiresearch/A-mem (agentic_memory/*.py) only. memory-bench's own fixed arm (servers/amem/fixed.py, 7 patches F1-F9) repairs exactly these defects — noted only in cite footnotes below, not drawn as a parallel flow.

A2 DISTILL is empty except one paper_only marker: analyze_content() is fully implemented (memory_system.py:159) but has zero call sites anywhere in the repo — every note's keywords/context/tags stay at their fallback defaults.
B3 EXPAND computes real graph-linked neighbors (:554-583), then B5's return memories[:k] (:585) discards every one of them — is_neighbor is False in 100% of returned results.
The fixed arm drops upstream's own consolidate hook entirely (fixed.py:385-387 has no threshold check) — an unintentional regression versus upstream, not a fix.
